entities.name: Drosophila PLK4 B3M6I4
observations: The 768-aa query matched reviewed UniProt B3M6I4 (Drosophila ananassae PLK4) at 100% identity and 100% query coverage; annotation transfer is strong homology support.
PLK4 is a serine/threonine protein kinase associated with centriole duplication; this functional description is reference-annotation evidence, not a direct assay of the query.
Query Pfam profile includes Pkinase (PF00069; residues 14–267), Plk4_PB1 (388–498), and Plk4_PB2 (500–598).

entities.name: Protein Ser Thr phosphorylation
observations: Generic kinase reactions: L-seryl-[protein] + ATP = O-phospho-L-seryl-[protein] + ADP + H+; L-threonyl-[protein] + ATP = O-phospho-L-threonyl-[protein] + ADP + H+. Rhea mappings include RHEA:17989 and RHEA:46608.
The sequence evidence supports kinase activity but does not identify a specific physiological substrate from sequence alone.
